weekLabel: Week of Jun 21-28 · refreshed Sun Jun 21. Tap a source to confirm before you go.

events.name: St. Peter's Fiesta - Gloucester
events.meta: Free · Gloucester waterfront. Cape Ann's signature festival: carnival rides, the greasy pole and seine boat races off Pavilion Beach, live music, food, blessing of the fleet. Ocean + seafood + teen magnet. Peaks the weekend of Jun 27-28. Go early, parking fills fast. source

events.name: Salisbury Beach Concerts + Fireworks - season opener
events.meta: Free · Salisbury oceanfront. First Saturday of the summer series: live concert on the Oceanfront Stage at 7:30pm, fireworks over the water 10:15-10:35pm. Easy beach evening for all five. source

events.when: Fri Jun 26 (match) + Fan Fest through Jun 27
events.name: World Cup at Gillette + FIFA Fan Festival
events.meta: Free fan fest · The tournament is at Gillette through Jul 9 (France v Norway Fri Jun 26, Round of 32 Jun 29). Tickets are pricey and parking heavy, so the family play is the free FIFA Fan Festival at Boston City Hall Plaza (livestreams, music, FIFA legends) running through Jun 27, or a local watch party. For Dave & Alex. source

events.name: SoWa Open Market
events.meta: Free entry · South End, Boston. 100+ vendors, food trucks, vintage and makers in a walkable block. Stacey's city-day pick - easy to graze and bail. source

events.name: North End Kids' Independence Celebration
events.meta: Free · Christopher Columbus Park, Boston. Magician, storyteller and games on the waterfront. Low-lift and good for Isabella; pair with a North End lunch. Confirm time (verify). source

events.name: Newburyport Farmers' Market + boardwalk
events.meta: Free · Newburyport. Market plus the boardwalk and waterfront park in one of the best walkable harbor towns in range. source

events.when: Wed Jun 24, 7pm (Infinity Song); Mon Jun 29, 7pm (Beatles tribute)
events.name: Prescott Park Arts Festival - Portsmouth NH
events.meta: $20 suggested donation · Portsmouth NH waterfront. Concerts on the Wilcox Main Stage (Infinity Song Wed, The Walrus / Beatles tribute Mon). Bring chairs, pair with a Portsmouth dinner. source

events.name: Nashua River Brewers Festival - Dave's brewery pick
events.meta: Ticketed (verify price) · Riverfront Park, Nashua NH. Top New England brewers in one outdoor riverfront spot, with Coastal Mass Brewing (Beverly) pouring. source

events.name: Boston Pops July 4 Fireworks Spectacular
events.meta: Free · Charles River Esplanade. The big holiday one: Lainey Wilson, Chance the Rapper and Trombone Shorty, fireworks at 9:15pm. Huge crowds, gates open noon - plan now. source

events.name: Yarmouth Clam Festival - Maine
events.meta: Free entry · Yarmouth ME. Classic Maine seafood weekend: clams, parade, live music, midway. Dave bait, worth the drive. source
